arrival_process_reproduction: Reproducing a self-similar or bursty arrival process from the source traces would require an open-loop generator issuing requests on a schedule rather than a closed-loop user model. That is a different load generator, not a parameter change. Deferred.
citation: M. Arlitt and T. Jin, "1998 World Cup Web Site Access Logs", August 1998. https://ita.ee.lbl.gov/html/contrib/WorldCup.html
envelope_claim: The selected aggregate window defines a closed-loop user-count envelope. Individual source arrivals are not replayed. Delivered arrival statistics are not established by this package; source Hurst is selection context only.
hurst_native_scope: source trace selection context only; not a property of the generated Locust load
hurst_note: hurst_native describes the source trace window we selected from, not the arrival process delivered to pods under Locust. No post-plateau Hurst value is published. The 36-plateau representation has too few points for an R/S estimate (minimum 64). The plateau representation destroys all sub-30s structure by construction.
shape_curve_validation_note: SHAPE_MEAN_USERS=45: Step 9 shape-curve (pre spawn-rate scaling fix), observed_sec=3. SHAPE_MEAN_USERS=400: revalidated post spawn-rate scaling fix (pre-fix observed_sec=5 at spawn_rate=60; post-fix observed_sec=3 at spawn_rate=89). SHAPE_MEAN_USERS=45 was not re-run post-fix; at ×45 the scaled _spawn_rate() is algebraically identical to pre-fix. Multiplier-independence is not claimed beyond shape_mean_users_validated.
